name: QoL extras
author: ZeldaWWHDRecomp contributors
description: Small gameplay extras, each switched on its own while you play: Link's clothes, replayed songs, picto subjects, album pages, songs by touch, one-hit kills, minigames by touch.

options.name: Link's clothes
options.description: The Hero's clothes or the casual clothes (the lobster shirt) at any time.

options.name: Replay conducted songs
options.description: After a song is conducted, Link plays it back before its effect, as on the GameCube.

options.name: Picto subjects
options.description: In the album, a label says whether the picto is good for a figurine, or why not.

options.name: Album pages
options.description: More pages of 12 pictos in the Picto Box album: L and ZL (or the arrows at the top) turn the pages. Page 1 is the game's own album; the other pages are kept in this package's files, never in your save.

options.name: Songs by touch
options.description: While Link holds up the Wind Waker: a button for each song he knows plays it, and four note pads conduct by touch.

options.name: One-hit kills
options.description: Every enemy goes down with any hit. Bosses that count their hits are not changed.

options.name: Minigames by touch
options.description: Sploosh Kaboom, the Cabana's puzzles, mail sorting, the cannon game, the auction and the Nintendo Gallery's figurines by touch or mouse.

setup.title: Build the QoL extras for this installation
